examples.name: Default
examples.summary: Four measured facts at the default `medium` scale. The unit rides in `suffix` and the qualifier in `prefix`, so the figure itself stays the largest, highest-contrast thing in each cell. Edit `items` in the Controls panel to see the band grow or shrink — a band with no items renders nothing at all.

examples.name: Sizes
examples.summary: Every `size` value, one band under the other. Only the figure moves up the big-number scale — the caption stays at overline scale and the cell keeps its frame, so a denser section can drop to `small` and a page hero can reach for `large` without the band changing shape.
